newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front - Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front - Aug 1.

text.p: The Washington Post included the following stories on its front page on Aug. 1:
WASHINGTON - New York police and federal agents arrested three men and secured five powerful bombs in a raid on a Brooklyn apartment.

RAMALLAH, WEST BANK - The day after twin suicide bombing attacks cut down 13 Israelis at a Jerusalem produce market, Israel's government lashed out as never before against the Palestinian Authority and its leader.
WASHINGTON - Fairfax County homeowners and officials are wondering what will happen to their neighborhoods now that Lorton Correctional Facility is due to be closed.

WASHINGTON - D.C. financial control board Chairman Andrew Brimmer said he will hire someone with senior-level management experience to oversee changes in the operations of nine major District government agencies.

WASHINGTON - The Army leadership has decided that four mid-level officers at the Aberdeen Ordnance Center and School should receive administrative punishment for failing to prevent a widespread sex scandal, while exonerating the two-star general in charge of the base.
WASHINGTON - The balanced budget agreement is hardly cause for celebration for millions of single working adults across the nation.
